Subject: Observability add-ons — retention + tracing + advanced dashboards (Cortex ask)

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the call earlier. As discussed, we're formalizing our ask so you have something to price. High level: Cortex Health needs a commercial option for production retention (2 years archival + hot window), distributed tracing retention for 90 days at span level, and an "advanced dashboards" pack (team-facing, ~10 dashboards to start).

Numbers to price against (monthly expected averages):
- Token generation / embeddings: ~35M tokens (burst to 80M)
- Trace spans: ~12M spans/day
- Dashboard users: 8 product/ops viewers, 3 editors

What we're specifically asking for:
1) A clear price comparison between: pay-as-you-go retention egress-ingest vs slab/commit buckets for retention storage.
2) Any startup/pilot credits you can offer for a 3-month ramp.
3) How advanced dashboards are licensed (per-seat, per-dashboard, or included in addon).
4) SLA for archival retrieval (RTO for 2-year archives) and any pricing premium for faster retrieval.

I've attached a simple spreadsheet with our expected month-by-month volumes and a procurement contact (Jared Stein) who will handle contracts.

Could you get back with a proposal and a sample MLP (minimal commercial path) we can pilot for 60 days? We're trying to decide between Redwood and another vendor, so clarity on the commercial structure will help.

Appreciate it — hope you can get something over early next week.

Best,
Alex

Head of ML Platforms, Cortex Health

Alex — thanks for the clear brief and the workbook. Looping in Ben (solutions) and Laura (AE) to scope commercial options.

High-level responses up front so you can share with the team:
- We can offer both slab (committed storage buckets) and pay-as-you-go (metered) for archival — the math tends to favor slabs once you exceed ~1.2TB/mo of cold writes. We'll include both line items in the proposal.
- Tracing: priced by ingest + retention window; 90 days at span level is straightforward but there is a RAM/ingest cost step for high QPS (we'll show both standard and "high-throughput" tiers).
- Dashboards: we support three licensing models; for a small ops/product org I usually recommend a bundled dashboard pack (fixed # of dashboards + up to N editors) rather than per-seat — cheaper and predictable.
- Pilot credit: we can offer a pilot credit (we typically do 15–25% off the first 2–3 months depending on the commit).

I'll get a short MLP (60-day pilot path) and a two-option commercial sheet over by EOD Wed. Laura — can you kick off the commercial draft and include a DocuSign-enabled SOW for the advanced dashboards? Ben — can you prepare a quick note on expected infra margin for the two retention sizing models (so I can sign off on any concessions)?

Thanks — talk soon.

Cheers,
Lukas Meyer
Sales, Redwood Inference
